Emergencies

Evacuazione della Cabina

An emergency procedure where passengers and crew exit the aircraft rapidly using all available exits, typically initiated after landing or in a critical situation.

Questions and answers

What is Evacuazione della Cabina?

In this glossary, Evacuazione della Cabina refers to: An emergency procedure where passengers and crew exit the aircraft rapidly using all available exits, typically initiated after landing or in a critical situation.

How is Evacuazione della Cabina used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Tower, stiamo iniziando l'evacuazione della cabina a causa di fumo dopo l'atterraggio."

Definition

An emergency procedure where passengers and crew exit the aircraft rapidly using all available exits, typically initiated after landing or in a critical situation.

Operational example

Tower, we are initiating a cabin evacuation due to smoke in the cabin after landing.
